evidence.quote: The Consensus API is now open to everyone
Calls are $0.05 each beyond the credits included in your plan (500 on Pro/Team/Enterprise, 2,000 on Deep) plus 1 additional credit per 100 papers.
Pagination beyond the first page and full-text chunks require Enterprise access

mcp.url: com.consensus-analytics/mcp (MCP registry listing, community-maintained; no vendor-published server found)

result.notes: Note: "consensus.app" (AI academic-research search engine) is a distinct company from "goconsensus.com" (B2B sales-demo software also branded "Consensus") — several third-party trackers (e.g. apitracker.io/a/consensus) conflate the two; disregard any goconsensus.com data. The official docs.consensus.app and help.consensus.app pages returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare bot-block) on direct fetch, so findings here rely on the consensus.app/home/api marketing page, the Composio toolkit page (which mirrors the official docs), and a third-party API guide (agentsapis.com) — lowering confidence versus a primary-source read. Access is via a self-serve "Create API key" flow with no approval/waitlist ("now open to everyone"), but usable credits are allocated per paid plan tier (Pro/Team/Enterprise: 500 credits; Deep: 2,000), with no evidence of a free-tier credit allocation, so classified as paid_plan rather than self_serve_free. Auth is a single x-api-key header (api_key), not OAuth — the task hint "(OAuth requested)" and the precomputed .well-known/oauth-authorization-server discovery URL likely relate to consensus.app's own user login/SSO rather than the public data API; this was not independently verified due to fetch-budget limits and repeated 403s on the consensus.app domain. Only one documented endpoint (quick_search) was found; pagination beyond page 1 and full-text chunk retrieval are gated to Enterprise. No official MCP server found; MCP registry shows only community/unrelated entries.
result.one_liner: Consensus is an AI-powered search engine that finds, ranks, and synthesizes findings from 220+ million peer-reviewed academic research papers.
